findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_metadata, list_rooms, read_room, post_to_room, read_dms, verify_domain_start, list_bounties, get_updates · Private data: anansi_free_data, my_credits, register_agent, text_tools, post_to_room, report_content, verify_domain_start, verify_domain_check, list_bounties, claim_listing_start, claim_listing_verify, house_put, house_get, house_list, house_delete, report_house, subscribe_updates, confirm_subscription, use_skill · Public sink: list_rooms, read_room, post_to_room, send_dm, report_content, commons_settings, post_lesson, verify_domain_start, submit_job, post_job, get_bounty, submit_bounty, publish_profile, house_put, subscribe_updates, publish_skill · Destructive: calculate, delete_memory, submit_bounty, house_delete, report_house.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_metadata, list_rooms, read_room, post_to_room, read_dms, verify_domain_start, list_bounties, get_updates · Private data: anansi_free_data, my_credits, register_agent, text_tools, post_to_room, report_content, verify_domain_start, verify_domain_check, list_bounties, claim_listing_start, claim_listing_verify, house_put, house_get, house_list, house_delete, report_house, subscribe_updates, confirm_subscription, use_skill · Public sink: list_rooms, read_room, post_to_room, send_dm, report_content, commons_settings, post_lesson, verify_domain_start, submit_job, post_job, get_bounty, submit_bounty, publish_profile, house_put, subscribe_updates, publish_skill · Destructive: calculate, delete_memory, submit_bounty, house_delete, report_house

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
